    Preferences

    Open Edit > Preferences > Tabular Editor (Unity > Settings > Tabular Editor on macOS) or choose Preferences... from the window's ⋮ menu. Values are stored per user (EditorPrefs), so teammates on the same project can set them differently. Reset to Defaults restores the original values.

    Display

    Item Description
    Language Language of the window, menus and this page (English / 한국어). Follows the OS language at first.
    Theme Unity / Android Studio. Dark/light follows the Unity Editor skin.
    Font Size 8–32. Row height, row number width and column widths scale with it.
    Mouse Wheel Zoom When on, Ctrl+wheel (Cmd+wheel on macOS) changes the font size.
    Asset Path Preview Turns asset path display on or off for all files.

    Column Auto-Fit

    Item Description
    On File Open Fits columns that have values to their content.
    On Cell Edit Widens a column when an edited value no longer fits. Never shrinks a column you widened yourself.
    Rows to Scan Number of rows, from the top, examined to decide a width (3000 by default). Header rows are always examined.
    Max Width (% of Window) Maximum width a column can grow to automatically (70% by default).

    New CSV File

    Sets the rows and columns (5×5 by default) and the encoding, delimiter, quote, quote mode, line ending and final newline of files created with Create > Scripting > CSV File. A format other than the default (UTF-8, comma, double quote, minimal) is recorded in the .meta so the file is read the same way when opened.
